title: textGrain watermarking is harder to detect: can sum-tests still do it optimally?
abstract: arXiv:2610.17655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Watermarking embeds an imperceptible signal in text from large language models that is statistically detectable with a secret key. The recent textGrain watermark (Li et. al. (2026b)) calibrates this signal against the model's sampling entropy through an explicit entropy budget, combining the stochasticity of Red-Green and the unbiasedness of Gumbel-max watermarks, and its accompanying report proposes a detector that sums pivotal statistics. We study when, and how efficiently, textGrain can be detected after human edits, modeled as a sparse mixture in which a fraction $\varepsilon_n\asymp n^{-p}$ of positions retain the watermark and token uncertainty decays as $n^{-q}$. First, entropy calibration comes at a cost: the minimax detection boundary of textGrain is $p+q=1/2$, so its detectable region is strictly smaller than that of Gumbel-max and maximal-coupling watermarks, whose boundary is $2p+q=1$. translated_title: textGrain 水印更难检测：求和检验还能实现最优检测吗？
translated_abstract: 水印技术在大语言模型生成的文本中嵌入一种不可感知的信号，借助密钥即可对其进行统计检测。近期的 textGrain 水印（Li 等人，2026b）通过显式的熵预算将该信号与模型的采样熵进行校准，融合了红-绿（Red-Green）水印的随机性与 Gumbel-max 水印的无偏性，其配套报告提出了一种对关键统计量求和的检测器。我们研究了在人工编辑之后，textGrain 何时以及能以多高的效率被检测到，其中人工编辑被建模为稀疏混合模型：比例为 $\varepsilon_n\asymp n^{-p}$ 的位置保留了水印，且 token 的不确定性以 $n^{-q}$ 的速度衰减。首先，熵校准是有代价的：textGrain 的极小极大检测边界为 $p+q=1/2$，因此其可检测区域严格小于 Gumbel-max 与最大耦合水印的可检测区域，后者的边界为 $2p+q=1$。这一代价源于 textGrain 的构造方式……
tldr: textGrain 水印的熵校准机制使其极小极大检测边界为 p+q=1/2，可检测区域严格小于边界为 2p+q=1 的 Gumbel-max 与最大耦合水印，表明熵校准是以牺牲可检测性为代价的。
en_tdlr: textGrain watermarking's entropy calibration leads to a minimax detection boundary of p+q=1/2, making its detectable region strictly smaller than that of Gumbel-max and maximal-coupling watermarks (boundary 2p+q=1), revealing that entropy calibration comes at the cost of detectability.
